messages:
Rina (Docs): Hi folks — opened PR updating the versioned migration guide and SDK snippets to reflect the renaming of the routing policy param. Need to coordinate merge relative to the docs cutoff on Mon 18:00 UTC. PR: https://git/repo/pulls/4480

Omar (Eng): Which param rename? Any runtime incompatibility we should call out?

Rina (Docs): `route_policy` -> `routing.policy` in the SDK examples. Also added a note about behavior when fallback routing is enabled. I included an example that uses feature-flag `routing-v2`.

Talia (Product): We should not expose the sample that references `routing-v2` publicly until the flag is enabled in prod. Suggest using frontmatter `draft: true` or mark the example with a small warning box.

Ken (Release): Cutoff is Mon 18:00 UTC. If CI preview passes and approvals are in, we can schedule a merge slot before the cutoff; otherwise it waits for next cycle. If we merge behind `draft: true`, the repo is updated but site won't surface it.

Rina (Docs): CI preview failing with snippet-lint: unknown field `routing.policy` format flagged. preview-bot shows: "snippet-lint: unknown param 'routing.policy' in yaml-block"

preview-bot: started preview run for PR #4480  job id p-9901

Omar (Eng): The SDK yaml snippets expect dotted keys as strings. Wrap the key in quotes in the snippet YAML: "routing.policy": "strict". Also add a compatibility note: SDK v1.4+ supports dotted keys.

Rina (Docs): Pushed fix and added `supported_sdk: ["1.4+"]` to frontmatter. Also set `draft: true` per product request so it won't appear until routing-v2 is on.

preview-bot: preview p-9901  lint passed, linkcheck passed, preview: https://docs-preview/internal/4480

Talia (Product): Reviewed. Content good. Please add a sentence in migration section: "If you rely on fallback routing, expect a short grace period where both behaviors are supported." Small nit on wording — Rina will patch.

Rina (Docs): Wording nit fixed. All required approvals requested: docs + eng + product.

Omar (Eng): LGTM. Approving.

Talia (Product): Approved.

Ken (Release): Added `merge-on-slot` label and scheduled Tue 10:00 UTC slot. Release-notes entry marked internal-only for now. Remember: when the feature flag gates, remove `draft: true` and schedule a publish.

Rina (Docs): Label added. We'll keep draft in place until product confirms flag rollout. CI green and approvals present. Queueing merge for Tue 10:00 UTC but will keep page hidden.

preview-bot: PR #4480 status: approvals=3, checks=passed, labels=[merge-on-slot, draft-ready]

Rina (Docs): Update: merged at 2024-11-19T10:00:08Z with `draft: true`. Page is in main but excluded from site. Will circle back once routing-v2 is live to flip draft and notify release for a public publish. :white_check_mark:

Ken (Release): Marked merged on release checklist. If product flips visibility later, please add a release-note entry for public changelog.

Omar (Eng): Good plan. Thanks everyone.

Talia (Product): I'll post here when routing-v2 rollout is confirmed. Closing thread for now"
